batch_node.name: FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog Hourly Schedule v0.2.0
batch_node.description: Seeds a Schedule that runs the FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog collector once per hour at minute 17 UTC (off the top of the hour, where most schedules fire). The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the KSI catalog collector entity (UUIDv5 derived from its registry scope:key per req-tap-cares-collector-model-10). Schedules are user-creatable per req-tap-cares-scheduler-model-6, so this is a normal node create, not an INTERNAL_ONLY trusted-internal write.

node.name: FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog Hourly
node.description: Refreshes the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators catalog from the upstream rules repo once per hour at minute 17 UTC.
